name: demopage
description: Build a deep, detailed DemoPage for your product from its code: map every page, write what each one does, approve what buyers see, and get a live narrated demo link for your website.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your product's code into a live, narrated demo
interface.longDescription: DemoPage gives your website visitors a live, narrated demo inside your real product. This plugin maps your product from its code (routes, screens, UI text, and end-to-end tests), adds the pages as candidates to your DemoPage, and turns your demo link on once you approve them. Your code stays on your machine: only page titles, addresses, visible text, and short descriptions are sent.
defaultPrompt: Build my DemoPage from this repo.
Which demo pages failed their check, and how do I fix them?
What did buyers ask in DemoPage demos this month?
